    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, fun s1 s2 r μ => ⟨fun s1' htr => ?_, fun s2' htr => ?_⟩⟩
  all_goals
    cases r with
    | choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        first
        | obtain ⟨s', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
          exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceL htr2, .bisim (hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2)⟩
        | obtain ⟨s', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
          exact ⟨s', Tr.choiceL htr2, .bisim (hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2)⟩
      | choiceR htr => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      first
      | obtain ⟨s', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
        exact ⟨s', htr2, .bisim (hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2)⟩
      | obtain ⟨s', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
        exact ⟨s', htr2, .bisim (hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2)⟩
